subject.title: [Feature Request]: No way to disable auto-compaction

question: Should `agents.defaults.compaction` expose an opt-out, and should that opt-out disable both proactive threshold compaction and automatic recovery after a context-overflow error?
rationale: The internal dependency setting proves feasibility, but repository policy treats new config as compatibility-sensitive and the choice changes whether sessions recover automatically or intentionally fail at their context limit.

options.title: Expose full automatic opt-out
options.body: Add a canonical boolean that disables all automatic compaction paths while preserving manual `/compact` and returning an explicit context-limit error.

options.title: Disable proactive compaction only
options.body: Keep overflow recovery enabled for safety while allowing users to disable threshold-based automatic compaction.

options.title: Fix accounting without a knob
options.body: Resolve the premature-compaction bugs and retain automatic compaction as mandatory core behavior.

recommendation.title: Expose full automatic opt-out
recommendation.body: Add a canonical boolean that disables all automatic compaction paths while preserving manual `/compact` and returning an explicit context-limit error.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the embedded runtime integration where OpenClaw and dependency compaction ownership meet.
